www.cityofpalmdaleca.gov

NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
SPEAKER FORMS: &nbspFor record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER 5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION MEETINGS.
2. ROLL CALL: MAYOR / CHAIR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM / VICE CHAIR BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS / DIRECTORS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA
3. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CLOSED SESSION ITEMS:
4. PRESENTATION BY CITY ATTORNEY/GENERAL COUNSEL of the following item to be discussed in Closed Session:
4.1 CC - The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of a Council discussion and to confer with the City Attorney and Personnel Manager in connection with contract terms and conditions in the upcoming Employment Agreement between the City and John J. Murphy, as City Manager.
This closed session is necessary because a public discussion of this item, prior to a complete discussion by the Council of contract and ordinance terms, conditions and options, would be prejudicial to the City.
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54957 and 54957.6.
4.2 CC - The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel and to receive direction from the City Council regarding the possible initiation of litigation by the City.
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL--ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
Initiation of litigation pursuant to paragraph (4) of subdivision
(d) of Section 54956.9: Number of cases - One.
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public or to disclose further the circumstances in this potential case; such disclosure may harm settlement attempts or other efforts to resolve the matter without litigation
4.3 CC - The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
Community Development Associates, et al. v. City of Palmdale, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court
Case No. 18STCV06968
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.4 CC - The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of conferring with and/or receiving advice from the City's legal counsel regarding the following pending litigation to which the City is a party:
City of Palmdale, et al. v. Westwind Enterprises LLC, et al.
Los Angeles County Superior Court
Case No. 19AVCV00653
This closed session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Sections 54956.9(a) and 54956.9(d)(1).
Closed session is recommended because the City will assess the merits and weaknesses of this matter and consider the City's perspective. Based on existing facts and circumstances it is in the opinion of the City Attorney that it would prejudice the position of the City to discuss this matter in public.
4.5 CC - The reason for holding a closed session is for the purpose of obtaining authorization and direction from the City Council to its designated negotiator regarding the following real property transactions - possible purchase of Successor Agency property.
City negotiator: J. J. Murphy, Assistant City Manager
Owners: Successor Agency of the City of Palmdale
Property Address: APN's 3003-081-924, 925 and 926
Palmdale Trade & Commerce Center
Transaction: Possible purchase of Successor Agency property
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54956.8. Closed session is recommended because the Council will be instructing the negotiator regarding terms and conditions for the possible continued leasing of the real property interest identified above.
4.6 SA - The reason for holding a closed session on is for the purpose of obtaining authorization and direction from the Successor Agency to its designated negotiator regarding the possible sale of the property listed below.
Property Owner: Successor Agency
Agency Negotiator: James Purtee, Executive Director
Possible Purchaser: The City of Palmdale
Properties : APN's 3003-081-924, 925 and 926
Palmdale Trade & Commerce Center (Convention Center)
This Closed Session is being held pursuant to the authority of California Government Code Section 54956.8. Closed session is recommended because the Successor Agency will be instructing its negotiator regarding terms and conditions of sale, including price and the form, manner and timing of payment, for the possible sale of the real properties identified above.
5. CLOSED SESSION.
6. ANNOUNCEMENT BY CITY ATTORNEY/GENERAL COUNSEL of item(s) discussed in Closed Session.
7. ADJOURN 5:00 P.M. CLOSED SESSION MEETING.
8. CALL TO ORDER 7:00 CC/SA/PCA/PFA MEETINGS.
9. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF OUR TROOPS.
10. ROLL CALL: MAYOR / CHAIR HOFBAUER, MAYOR PRO TEM / VICE CHAIR BISHOP, COUNCILMEMBERS / DIRECTORS / MEMBERS BETTENCOURT, CARRILLO, AND LOA

11.1 Palmdale Animal Care Center representative will present a cute critter that is available for adoption from our local Animal Care Center.
11.2 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Commendation to City Manager Purtee in recognition of his retirement from the City of Palmdale and 31 years of public service.
11.3 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Commendation to Rachel Garcia for her many successes on the softball field and being a role model for young student athletes everywhere by continuing to give back to her community through service and outreach.
11.4 Presentation by Mayor and Council of a Proclamation to Paul George proclaiming December 29, 2019 as Paul George Day in the City of Palmdale for his generous contributions to the community.
